title: Cache template reads
prompt: Cache template file reads so repeated renders of the same path do not hit the filesystem again. Keep render's signature unchanged and make the included tests pass. Work directly in the repository, run the relevant tests, and do not commit.

files.tests/test_templates.py:
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from templates import render


class RenderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_repeated_render_uses_cached_file(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "welcome.txt"
            path.write_text("Hello {{name}}", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual("Hello Ada", render(path, "Ada"))
            path.write_text("Changed {{name}}", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual("Hello Lin", render(path, "Lin"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
